description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Extra Gazettes No. 2281/41 of 27.05.2022 (Amendment to the Duties and Functions)
reasoning: This gazette contains both a named individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends the assignment of specific departments, statutory institutions, public corporations, and laws to the Minister of Technology and Investment Promotion, including detailed descriptions of duties, functions, and the legal framework to be implemented. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (the President making the changes) and "what" (detailed ministerial responsibilities and portfolio assignments).
